mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD AS a INNER JOIN GESTURE_FORUM_USER AS b ON a.threadOwner = b.ccode LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_CATEGORY AS c ON a.threadCategory = c.cateNo LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD_LIKE AS d ON a.threadNo = d.threadNo AND d.ccode = #{ccode} ORDER BY a.openDate DESC

SELECT a.threadNo, a.threadTitle, FN_SIMPLIFY_THREAD_HEAD_POST(b.content) AS threadContent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GESTURE_THREAD_POST WHERE threadNo = a.threadNo AND !isHeadPost) AS answerCnt, a.threadViews, a.threadLikeCnt, a.threadOwner, c.userNm AS threadOwnerNm, d.cateNmKr AS threadCateNmKr, d.cateNmEn AS threadCateNmEn, a.isOpen AS threadIsOpen, a.isPrivate AS threadIsPrivate, a.isNotice AS threadIsNotice, DATE_FORMAT(a.openDate, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS threadOpenDate, FN_GET_BEFORE_TIME_SIMPLE(a.openDate, #{countryCd}) AS threadAgoTime FROM GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD AS a LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_POST AS b ON a.threadNo = b.threadNo AND b.isHeadPost INNER JOIN GESTURE_FORUM_USER AS c ON a.threadOwner = c.ccode LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_CATEGORY AS d ON a.threadCategory = d.cateNo LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD_LIKE AS e ON a.threadNo = e.threadNo AND e.ccode = #{ccode} ORDER BY isNotice DESC, ${orderTarget} DESC LIMIT ${pageTarget}, 20

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD AS a LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_POST AS b ON a.threadNo = b.threadNo INNER JOIN GESTURE_FORUM_USER AS c ON a.threadOwner = c.ccode LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_CATEGORY AS d ON a.threadCategory = d.cateNo LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD_LIKE AS e ON a.threadNo = e.threadNo AND e.ccode = #{ccode} WHERE a.threadTitle LIKE '%${searchKeyword}%' OR b.content LIKE '%${searchKeyword}%' GROUP BY a.threadNo) AS a

SELECT a.threadNo, a.threadTitle, (SELECT FN_SIMPLIFY_THREAD_HEAD_POST(content) FROM GESTURE_THREAD_POST WHERE threadNo = a.threadNo AND isHeadPost) AS threadContent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GESTURE_THREAD_POST WHERE threadNo = a.threadNo AND !isHeadPost) AS answerCnt, a.threadViews, a.threadLikeCnt, a.threadOwner, c.userNm AS threadOwnerNm, d.cateNmKr AS threadCateNmKr, d.cateNmEn AS threadCateNmEn, a.isOpen AS threadIsOpen, a.isPrivate AS threadIsPrivate, a.isNotice AS threadIsNotice, DATE_FORMAT(a.openDate, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS threadOpenDate, FN_GET_BEFORE_TIME_SIMPLE(a.openDate, #{countryCd}) AS threadAgoTime FROM GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD AS a LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_POST AS b ON a.threadNo = b.threadNo INNER JOIN GESTURE_FORUM_USER AS c ON a.threadOwner = c.ccode LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_CATEGORY AS d ON a.threadCategory = d.cateNo LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD_LIKE AS e ON a.threadNo = e.threadNo AND e.ccode = #{ccode} WHERE a.threadTitle LIKE '%${searchKeyword}%' OR b.content LIKE '%${searchKeyword}%' GROUP BY a.threadNo ORDER BY isNotice DESC, ${orderTarget} DESC LIMIT ${pageTarget}, 20

SELECT a.threadNo, a.threadTitle, a.threadViews, a.threadLikeCnt, a.threadOwner, b.userNm AS threadOwnerNm, b.countryCd AS threadCountryCd, c.cateNmKr AS threadCateNmKr, c.cateNmEn AS threadCateNmEn, a.isOpen AS threadIsOpen, DATE_FORMAT(a.openDate, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS threadOpenDate, FN_GET_BEFORE_TIME_SIMPLE(a.openDate, #{countryCd}) AS threadAgoTime, IF(d.threadNo IS NULL, 0, 1) AS isThreadLike FROM GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD AS a INNER JOIN GESTURE_FORUM_USER AS b ON a.threadOwner = b.ccode LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_CATEGORY AS c ON a.threadCategory = c.cateNo LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD_LIKE AS d ON a.threadNo = d.threadNo AND d.ccode = #{ccode} WHERE a.threadNo = ${threadNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD SET threadViews = threadViews + 1 WHERE threadNo = ${threadNo}
mapper.select: SELECT a.threadNo, b.postNo, a.threadTitle, a.threadCategory AS threadCateNo, b.content AS threadContent, a.threadOwner, a.isPrivate AS threadIsPrivate FROM GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD AS a INNER JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_POST AS b ON a.threadNo = b.threadNo AND b.isHeadPost WHERE a.threadNo = ${threadNo}

SELECT a.postNo, a.threadNo, a.content, a.writer, a.likeCnt, a.dislikeCnt, a.isHeadPost, c.isPostLike, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GESTURE_THREAD_POST_COMMENT WHERE threadNo = a.threadNo AND postNo = a.postNo AND isRemove = 0) AS commentCnt, b.userNm AS postWriter, FN_GET_BEFORE_TIME_SIMPLE(a.regDate, #{countryCd}) AS postAgoTime, DATE_FORMAT(a.regDate, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS regDate FROM GESTURE_THREAD_POST AS a INNER JOIN GESTURE_FORUM_USER AS b ON a.writer = b.ccode LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_POST_LIKE AS c ON a.threadNo = c.threadNo AND a.postNo = c.postNo AND c.ccode = #{ccode} WHERE a.threadNo = ${threadNo} ORDER BY postNo ASC

SELECT cateNo, cateNmKr, cateNmEn FROM GESTURE_THREAD_CATEGORY WHERE isUse AND cateNo != IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GESTURE_FORUM_USER WHERE ccode = #{ccode} AND userType = 'ADMIN'), 0, 6) ORDER BY cateNo
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD (threadTitle, threadOwner, threadCategory, isPrivate, isNotice) VALUES (#{threadTitle}, ${threadOwner}, ${threadCateNo}, ${threadIsPrivate}, ${threadIsNotice})
INSERT INTO GESTURE_THREAD_POST (threadNo, content, writer, isHeadPost) VALUES (${threadNo}, #{threadContent}, ${threadOwner}, 1)
INSERT INTO GESTURE_THREAD_POST (threadNo, content, writer) VALUES (${threadNo}, #{postContent}, ${postWriter})
mapper.select: SELECT content FROM GESTURE_THREAD_POST WHERE threadNo = ${threadNo} AND postNo = ${postNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT content FROM GESTURE_THREAD_POST WHERE threadNo = ${threadNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD AS a INNER JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_POST AS b ON a.threadNo = b.threadNo SET a.threadTitle = #{threadTitle}, a.threadCategory = #{threadCateNo}, b.content = #{threadContent}, a.isPrivate = ${threadIsPrivate} WHERE a.threadNo = ${threadNo} AND (a.threadOwner = #{threadOwner} OR #{threadOwner} = 0) AND b.postNo = ${postNo} AND b.isHeadPost
UPDATE GESTURE_THREAD_POST SET content = #{postContent}, editDate = NOW() WHERE threadNo = ${threadNo} AND postNo = ${postNo} AND (writer = #{postWriter} OR #{postWriter} = 0) AND !isHeadPost
mapper.delete: DELETE a, b FROM GESTURE_THREAD_POST AS a LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_POST_LIKE AS b ON a.threadNo = b.threadNo AND a.postNo = b.postNo WHERE a.threadNo = ${threadNo} AND a.postNo = ${postNo} AND (a.writer = #{ccode} OR #{ccode} = 0) AND !a.isHeadPost

DELETE a, b, c, d FROM GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD AS a LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD_LIKE AS b ON a.threadNo = b.threadNo LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_POST AS c ON a.threadNo = c.threadNo LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_POST_LIKE AS d ON a.threadNo = d.threadNo WHERE a.threadNo = ${threadNo} AND (a.threadOwner = #{threadOwner} OR #{threadOwner} = 0)
